### Reproduction

I'm attempting to train a Lora adapter on a local copy of Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct with a config like this:

```
warmup_steps = 0
max_seq_length = 2560

processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(model_name)
model = Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained(
    model_name,
    dtype=(
        torch.bfloat16 if torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported() else torch.float16
    ),
)

peft_config = LoraConfig(
    r=64,
    lora_alpha=128,
    target_modules=[
            "q_proj",
            "k_proj",
            "v_proj",
            "o_proj",
        ],
    lora_dropout=0.05,
    bias="none",
    task_type="CAUSAL_LM",
)

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  DATASET (customize preprocessing!)
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────
train_dataset = load_dataset("train")
eval_dataset = load_dataset("test")


# ────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  TRAINING ARGUMENTS
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────
training_args = SFTConfig(
    output_dir=output_dir,
    num_train_epochs=num_epochs,
    per_device_train_batch_size=per_device_batch_size,
    per_device_eval_batch_size=per_device_batch_size,
    learning_rate=learning_rate,
    warmup_steps=warmup_steps,
    eval_strategy="steps",
    save_strategy="steps",
    save_steps=int(len(train_dataset) / 2),
    eval_steps=int(len(train_dataset) / 2),
    logging_steps=10,
    metric_for_best_model="eval_loss",
    load_best_model_at_end=True,
    max_grad_norm=1,
    ddp_find_unused_parameters=False,
    dataset_kwargs={"skip_prepare_dataset": True},
    remove_unused_columns=False,
    optim="adamw_torch",
    completion_only_loss=True,
    max_length=max_seq_length
)

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  TRAIN
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────


trainer = SFTTrainer(
    model=model,
    args=training_args,
    train_dataset=train_dataset,
    eval_dataset=eval_dataset,
    peft_config=peft_config,
    processing_class=processor,
)

trainer.train()

```

If I downgrade to transformers 5.2.0, it works just fine.  I only see this error on 5.3.0 and I also see it with a model of a different architecture (GLM-4.6V-Flash).

My dataset is custom, but laid out in [prompt-completion](https://huggingface.co/docs/trl/dataset_formats#prompt-completion) format with an ["image" column](https://huggingface.co/docs/trl/dataset_formats#vision-datasets) with a single PIL image.  The dataset was working (as was the rest of the code) on earlier transformers version.

comments.body:
oh I love Qwen and position ids 🫠 

I think the correct fix on TRL wasn't yet released for this and you might want to try again by installing from source @akowalsk . See related https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/44384#issuecomment-3997014468
Installing TRL from source worked.  Thanks!
